sloka: तं मातरो बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्यो दु:खेन नामन्त्रयितुं हि शेकु: ।स त्वेव मातऽरभिवाद्य सर्वा रुदन् कुटीं स्वां प्रविवेश राम: ॥ २.११२.३१ ॥
transliteration: taṁ mātaro bāṣpagṛhītakaṇṭhyo du:khena nāmantrayituṁ hi śeku: ।sa tveva māta'rabhivādya sarvā rudan kuṭīṁ svāṁ praviveśa rāma: ॥ 2.112.31 ॥

translations.english: His mothers were unable to bid him farewell their throats were choked with tears of sorrow but Rama himself paid obeisance to them and entered his hut in tears. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredtwelfth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
